blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Raffy Tulfo on Tuesday reprimanded the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) after it revealed that consumer complaints could take up to seven months to be resolved. Tulfo raised concerns about the DTI’s implementation of the No Return, No Exchange policy during the Senate finance subcommittee budget hearing, saying he still receives several complaints about defective products that are hard to return because sellers are evasive. DTI Fair Trade Group Asec. Regino Mallari said the agency has a consumer care unit that initially processes complaints through mediation between the parties.
